governance: Issue #4 D-12D-001; requires itemized owner approval before any new physical call
supersedes_note: The original 11-case proposal called its 6 LF cases VSPAERO, but 2 are RCAIDE Mission tail probes. This document corrects the method and scope; the earlier hashed review run is kept unchanged.

nominal_existing_cases.warning: An alpha sweep, restart or verification grid may involve more than one actual solver invocation; these are nominal cases, not a bounded authorization of 11 physical solves.

ordered_preconditions: Document each exact Mach/Re/alpha/beta, wing geometry and Sref/cref/bref in SI; identify wind versus body axes and force sign.
Verify 12D loader/DOΕ/Mission software on local project interpreter and A5 independent review.
Verify W10 OpenVSP exported surface twist with the actual worker and preserve geometry hashes; compare wing-only geometry handed to VSPAERO and SU2.
Confirm mesh-generation method, farfield conditions, wall boundary treatment and geometry origin for any SU2 wing-only case; an absence blocks the SU2 case.
Obtain owner-signed physical-call budget and stop conditions in Issue #4; do not interpret this JSON as approval.
validation_cautions: One Mach-2 wedge SU2 solve may check shock angle on its chosen grid but cannot demonstrate wedge grid independence. Add independently converged reference evidence or an approved multi-grid wedge verification series.
A three-grid wing-only Euler study can investigate wing pressure and wave drag but cannot prove full-aircraft fuel accuracy or viscous/skin-friction accuracy.
Mach2.02 VSPAERO thin-surface comparisons require correct vortex panel resolution, sweep, Mach-mode settings, convergence and same force reference.
Vertical-tail V01/V02 probes are RCAIDE LF Mission, not VSPAERO; wing-only SU2 does NOT validate vertical-tail effects.
Induced and wave-lift terms both scaling with CL^2 is a reason to investigate overlap, not proof of double counting. Diagnose with independent force-level component comparisons.
Baseline wing wetted area is 717.57475 m2; the 358.25 m2 number is reference/exposed area in the historical model. Unmodelled wing-body occlusion remains a source of error.

body_correction_gate.reason: The nominal 11 cases include no calibrated wing-body interference comparison and cannot validate a design-dependent fuselage correction even if every wing-only case converges.
body_correction_gate.minimum_additional_evidence: Independent wing-body baseline/reference data or an approved limited full-configuration aerodynamic comparison over representative wing perturbations, with overlap and uncertainty ledger; exact case count and budget TBD, not authorized.
body_correction_gate.fallback: If no independent source is obtainable, report BODY-CORR NOT_VALIDATED and limit optimization claims; do not auto-approve P4.

cost_envelope.restart_policy: Every re-solve/restart counts as another real call unless documented as same continuous solver run.
stop_conditions: per-case approved wall-time or compute budget exhausted
unexpected negative or duplicated drag component

next_decisions: Accept the corrected nominal breakdown (4 VSPAERO, 2 RCAIDE Mission, 5 SU2) as a technical planning basis only.
Define wedge grid-independent acceptance method and whether additional calls are required.
Define body-correction calibration evidence and tolerable uncertainty, potentially expanding the matrix.
Approve explicit case-level run caps and resources if and only if the non-physical prerequisites pass.
